input: Book a private dining experience for mom's milestone birthday

gold.taskTitle: Book Private Dining for Mom's Milestone Birthday
gold.taskDescription: Research and reserve a private dining experience to celebrate mom's milestone birthday.

questions.title: What milestone birthday is your mom celebrating?
questions.description: Identify the specific age milestone to help match the scale and tone of the experience.

questions.title: What is the target date for the dinner?
questions.description: Pin down the exact or preferred date to check availability at venues.

questions.title: How many guests will be attending the dinner?
questions.description: Determine the headcount to filter venues by private room capacity.

questions.title: What city or neighborhood should the restaurant be in?
questions.description: Narrow the search to a specific location convenient for the guest of honor and attendees.

questions.title: What is your total budget for the entire event?
questions.description: Establish a budget ceiling to filter venues by price range per head or minimum spend.

questions.title: What cuisine type or dining style does your mom prefer?
questions.description: Identify food preferences or styles to match the venue to her tastes.

questions.title: Are there any dietary restrictions among the guests?
questions.description: Collect allergy or dietary requirement details to confirm the venue can accommodate everyone.
